caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, double-breasted overcoat with a high, wide lapel and a contrasting lighter brown collar. The coat features six metallic buttons arranged in two rows of three on the front, and two additional metallic buttons on the lower part of the front panels. The coat is long-sleeved with a tailored fit, slightly flaring out towards the bottom. The background is a plain, light beige color. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, uncolored sketched outline of the same coat shown from the back, which displays seam lines and suggests a fitted cut at the waist. The materials and overall finish have a matte appearance.
title: Tail Coat
